description: This file contains JUnit 5 test cases for the Allergies class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing allergy management functionalities such as adding, removing, and validating allergies.

classes.name: AllergiesTest
classes.description: JUnit 5 test class for validating the behavior of the Allergies class in the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test data and configures allergy testing environment before each test.

methods.name: shouldAddAllergyAndSetCorrectStatus
methods.description: Tests adding allergies, inserting at specific position, and updating allergy list status.

methods.name: shouldAddAllergyCollectionAndSetCorrectStatus
methods.description: Tests adding a collection of allergies to the Allergies object with correct status updates.

methods.name: shouldRemoveAllergyAndSetCorrectStatus
methods.description: Tests removing allergies and verifying the list status updates accordingly.

methods.name: shouldClearAllergyAndSetCorrectStatus
methods.description: Tests clearing all allergies from the list and verifying status changes.

methods.name: shouldConfirmNoKnownAllergies
methods.description: Tests confirming that there are no known allergies and setting status accordingly.

methods.name: shouldThrowAnErrorWhenTryingConfirmNoKnowAllergiesWhileAllergiesIsNotEmpty
methods.description: Verifies exception is thrown if 'confirmNoKnownAllergies' is called on a non-empty allergy list.

methods.name: add_shouldNotAllowDuplicateCodedAllergen

methods.description: Tests that adding different coded allergens is allowed.

methods.name: add_shouldAllowNonDuplicateNonCodedAllergen
methods.description: Tests that adding different non-coded allergens is permitted.

methods.name: add2_shouldNotAllowDuplicateNonCodedAllergen
methods.description: Tests duplicate non-coded allergen addition at specific index throws exception.

methods.name: add2_shouldAllowNonDuplicateNonCodedAllergen
methods.description: Tests adding different non-coded allergens at specific index.

methods.name: addAll_shouldNotAllowDuplicateCodedAllergen

methods.name: addAll_shouldNotAllowDuplicateNonCodedAllergen
methods.description: Tests adding a collection with duplicate non-coded allergens throws exception.

methods.name: addAll_shouldAllowNonDuplicateNonCodedAllergen
